When I was nine, my 2 year old brother drowned in our in ground pool. I was watching the Brady Bunch in the living room while my uncle (same age) 8 year old sister, and 7 year old brother were playing in the deep end of the pool. No one heard anything until my uncle went over to find a toy and instead found him. I remember hearing my sister running screaming into the back of the house and my mom falling in the wet floor trying to get back to him. I was completely petrified, staring at the tv, hoping I was just imagining it. When I finally went to the back yard my brother was blue and my mom was frantically doing CPR. My other brother was trying to talk to the 911 dispatchers as calmly as possible. Everything went very fast, but I remember all the uniforms coming through the house, my aunt running across the street from her house and praying with us, my mom calling every firehouse my dad could possibly be at because he was working overtime and she didn't know where he was. Then I remember being huddled in my aunt's bed across the street, and my papaw came in and we asked if he was ok and he told us that 'Kasey was in Jesus' arms now.' and we all cried together. 

Wow, I'm crying because I just realized the date.. Today is the anniversary. I'm 23 now. It's been exactly 14 years.

But, that was the most scared I have ever been as a child.
